call_points.text: Management expects FY27 to be a better year than FY26, but gives no numeric revenue or margin guidance.
US scaffolding demand has recovered since December 2025 and momentum continues into the June quarter.
Forex gain was ₹20 Cr in Q4 and ₹46 Cr for FY26; management says it recurs and is not one-time.
Plans a ₹150 Cr second-phase formwork and extrusion expansion towards FY27-end, with benefit in FY28-FY29.
US tariffs are 50% on scaffolding and 27.6% on drum closures, but management says these are passed on to customers.
Defence division has no update; samples are being approved by DRDO but no revenue or target is shared.
Yarn business is at about 10% EBITDA margin; fabric division restructuring is under evaluation with no guidance.

deals.execution_by: towards the end of this financial year or early next financial year

tax_litigation.status: The Company had received a notice/assessment order for the assessment year 2023-24 for a sum of Rs. 42. 32 Lakhs, The Company has filed appeal against the said notice/order which is pending before CIT Appeals.

industry: Industrials > Capital Goods > Industrial Products > Iron & Steel Products

operating_notes.text: Scaffoldings division FY26 revenue ₹1,342.53 Cr, the largest segment at 48.66% of segment revenue.
FY26 operating cash flow ₹243.48 Cr against EBITDA of ₹467.84 Cr.
Scaffolding division FY26 revenue was ₹1,342 Cr, split roughly 50-50 between scaffolding (₹680 Cr) and formwork (₹660 Cr).
Mach One order book exceeds 4.5 lakh sq m, more than six months of current production capacity; utilisation is 60-70%.
Middle East accounted for about 15% of scaffolding division revenue in FY26; South America was about 3% of formwork volume.

timeline.summary: Technocraft Industries reported Q4 FY26 consolidated operating revenue of ₹711.70 Cr and a 17% increase in PAT to ₹77.74 Cr.
Technocraft Industries (India) Limited shared the audio recording of its Q4 FY2026 financial results conference call via **Neeraj Rai**, dated May 29, 2026.

Technocraft Industries held its Q4FY26 earnings call on May 29, 2026, guiding to a better FY27 on US scaffolding recovery and stable drum closures, with a ₹150 Cr formwork expansion planned for FY27-end.
Technocraft Industries received an ESG score of 56 from CRISIL ESG Ratings & Analytics Limited.
